rationale: Round 1 lost on both sides in all 48 variants and both neighbors, so a close beyond the 00:00-02:00 range is mostly a false break that reverts, and the main setting is how many minutes to wait before fading it. Losing side: Traders who chase the first break of the 00:00-02:00 range and are left holding the wrong side when price returns inside.
notes: win_break: the range of the 1-minute bars in [r_start, r_end) (any window of the day) is broken by a tf bar's CLOSE after r_end -> a market entry with the break (follow) or against it (fade), or a limit at the broken edge (retest); one trade a session in the pass of the break
